headlines.title: AppLovin Stock Has One Thing Left To Prove
headlines.summary: AppLovin (APP) stock has lost 55.6% over the past year, trailing a 17.3% return for the S&P 500. Following that decline, shareholders may be counting on a newer line of business: selling web ads to online sellers, rather than just placing them in mobile games. The catch is that AppLovin has yet to show these sellers will actually spend money on a platform best known for games.

headlines.title: 3 Big Reasons to Love AppLovin (APP)
headlines.summary: Shareholders of AppLovin would probably like to forget the past six months even happened. The stock has dropped 44.7% and now trades at a new 52-week low of $257.12. This was partly driven by its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.

headlines.title: AppLovin Q3 seen by Wedbush as key test of model update
headlines.summary: AppLovin Corp (NASDAQ:APP) is valued as if it is losing market share, but Wedbush Securities says its checks show otherwise. Advertisers the firm spoke with held spend steady in the third quarter and expect an e-commerce-led lift in the fourth.

headlines.title: AppLovin (APP) Following Strong Q2 Results Has Its Valuation Story Changed
headlines.summary: AppLovin (APP) just posted a 53% jump in second quarter 2026 revenue and even faster profit growth, yet the share price has retreated sharply, forcing investors to weigh fundamentals against market skepticism.

headlines.title: Unity Software Sinks 10% Despite Wedbush Target Hike on Vector Ad Platform; AppLovin Falls 3%, Trade Desk Slips
headlines.summary: Wedbush just raised its price target on Unity Software and praised its Vector ad platform, yet the stock is sinking hard while rivals escape with minor bruises. Something beyond the numbers is spooking investors, and the answer cuts to the heart of whether Vector can actually challenge AppLovin.

description: AppLovin Corporation provides end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered advertising solutions for businesses in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Advertising and Apps. The company offers Axon Ads Manager, a suite of marketing solutions that enables developers to automate, optimize, and manage marketing efforts; MAX, an in-app bidding technology that optimizes the value of a publisher's advertising inventory by running a real-time competitive auction; Adjust, a measurement and analytics marketing platform; and Wurl, a connected TV platform, which distributes streaming video for content companies, provides advertising and publishing solutions. It serves individuals, small and independent businesses, enterprises, advertisers and advertising networks, mobile app publishers, and indie studio developers. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
